public_rationale: The original paper demonstrates vulnerabilities, not their permanent unfixability. Neither source meets the decisive-event rule. With no deadline, the forecast remains open.
limitations: Finite experiments cannot establish an endless future sequence of vulnerabilities.
Mitigation of selected effects is weaker than comprehensive remediation.
